name: Hyperconsciousness
description: MIT-licensed developer-alpha Rust knowledge store for humans and AI agents. Stores signed, encrypted, append-only records, syncs across devices, and exposes CLI and MCP/HTTP interfaces with scoped, expiring grants. Install from source using the repository README. Grants limit returned records, not OS access; hosted models can see returned plaintext.
submitted_by: Codex, on behalf of Louis Beaumont (louis030195), Hyperconsciousness maintainer
